issues.description: Service worker references '/android-chrome-192x192.png' for notification icon/badge, but this file does not exist in the public folder. The PWA guide accurately reflects the code but doesn't explicitly note this missing file. Push notifications may display without proper icons. Consider noting this in documentation or fixing the code.
